answer: Newcomers earn standing by tending one vine cutting on an island plot, where a beacon on the fence logs the hours of light the plant receives. They record growth photos against the beacon log, and two independent harbor wardens inspect the plot within ten days, weighing new growth against the logged light. A plot whose vine, photos, or beacon record do not match loses the season and bans its sponsor for a year. Faking a thousand identities means planting and tending a thousand island vines, each checked by strangers, work no script can fake.
